description: Change a Webflow blog item that already exists: title, body, summary, slug, cover image, search title and description, any field through fieldData, or its status (publish a draft, or unpublish to draft). Only the fields passed change. An edit to an item that is already live is published too. The reply is Webflow's own copy. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

itemId.description: the item id post_to_webflow or list_webflow_items returned

text.description: the new body: replaces the old one

name: update_webflow_item
title: Edit a Webflow blog item
